title: CEFR-oriented Russian Text Simplification Using Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a study on controlled automatic simplification of Russian texts using preference-based optimization algorithms with a focus on adapting texts to the A1, A2 and B1 proficiency levels. We fine-tune YandexGPT using Rejection Sampling and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) methods to improve control over the complexity of the generated text. We compare several training configurations that differ in dataset composition, text type and the strategy used to construct preference pairs for DPO. For automatic evaluation we train a regression model based on ruRoBERTa-large to predict continuous complexity scores corresponding to CEFR levels. We also consider semantic similarity, lexical coverage and quantitative readability metrics. Human evaluation assesses simplicity, fluency and adequacy. translated_title: 基于强化学习的面向CEFR的俄语文本简化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一项关于俄语文本受控自动简化的研究，采用基于偏好的优化算法，重点是将文本适配至A1、A2和B1语言熟练水平。我们使用拒绝采样和直接偏好优化（DPO）方法对YandexGPT进行微调，以提升对生成文本复杂度的控制能力。我们比较了多种训练配置，这些配置在数据集组成、文本类型以及DPO偏好对构建策略方面各不相同。在自动评估方面，我们训练了一个基于ruRoBERTa-large的回归模型，用于预测对应CEFR级别的连续复杂度分数。我们还考虑了语义相似度、词汇覆盖率和量化可读性指标。人工评估则考察了简洁性、流畅性和充分性。我们表现最佳的模型实现了87.15%的目标级别准确率，MAE为0.35个CEFR级别，目标区间MAE为0.11。人工评估显示，部分模型生成的简化文本在质量上表现良好。
tldr: 该研究利用拒绝采样和直接偏好优化（DPO）等偏好优化方法微调YandexGPT，实现了将俄语文本自动简化至CEFR的A1、A2和B1语言水平的可控简化，最佳模型达到87.15%的目标级别准确率。
en_tdlr: This study fine-tunes YandexGPT using preference-based optimization methods (Rejection Sampling and DPO) to achieve controlled simplification of Russian texts to CEFR A1, A2, and B1 proficiency levels, with the best model achieving 87.15% target-level accuracy.
